title: QIDI Box heaters: keep-alive sent earlier, no "max_duration" MCU shutdown while drying (QIDI_Q2 #34)

edits:
self.next_pwm_time = pwm_time + 0.75 * MAX_HEAT_TIME
        self.next_pwm_time = pwm_time + (0.25 if 'heater_box' in self.name else 0.75) * MAX_HEAT_TIME  # q2-box-heater-keepalive (QIDI_Q2 issue #34)

note: Tested by the issue reporter: 8000+ tool changes with 3-4 Boxes drying, 0 shutdowns. Affects only heaters whose name contains heater_box.
